notes: Account: product analytics platform used by mid-market B2B SaaS customers; strong focus on real-time support assistant and embeddings-based doc search.
Initial ask: start on Hosted API to get going quickly, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation once POC shows unit economics.

POC scope agreed: chat support assistant + vector search for KB. POC KPIs: <120ms median token latency for chat generate, 90k qps/day embedding throughput for nightly indexing pipeline, cost < $100k ARR runway target.
Cost sensitivity: CFO wants clear unit economics. Target: cheaper than current self-hosted GPU infra by 20% while hitting latency targets.
